description.narrative: Mongolia - Health Project - NCDI Prevention Activity: MCC Funding will be used to reduce factors for NCDIs through such behavior change communications as public awareness campaigns and education outreach. Specifically, MCC Funding will support: (i) development of national and regional NCDI communications campaigns, such as mass media, health fairs, work sites and mobile units promoting healthy lifestyles; and (ii) development and implementation of interventions to promote behavior change among youth and high risk individuals to prevent NCDIs.
